bss.topic: Revisão: minha história, a comunidade e o trabalho

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que é uma linha do tempo?
options: Uma forma de organizar fatos na ordem em que aconteceram
questions.answer: Uma forma de organizar fatos na ordem em que aconteceram
questions.hint: Pense em antes, durante e depois.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Numa linha do tempo da sua vida, o que vem primeiro?
options: O dia em que você nasceu
questions.answer: O dia em que você nasceu
questions.hint: Qual desses fatos aconteceu antes de todos?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes é uma fonte histórica escrita?
questions.hint: Fonte escrita tem palavras.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes é uma fonte histórica oral?
options: A história que a avó conta sobre sua infância
questions.answer: A história que a avó conta sobre sua infância
questions.hint: Oral vem de boca: o que as pessoas falam.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Uma foto antiga da família é que tipo de fonte histórica?
questions.hint: Pense no sentido que usamos para ver a foto.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quantos anos tem um século?
questions.hint: É um número redondo bem grande, maior que 10.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Quantos anos tem uma década?
questions.hint: Pense em dezena.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: O que é uma comunidade?
options: Um grupo de pessoas que vivem ou convivem num mesmo lugar e compartilham coisas
questions.answer: Um grupo de pessoas que vivem ou convivem num mesmo lugar e compartilham coisas
questions.hint: Seu bairro e sua escola são exemplos.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual profissional cuida da saúde dos dentes?
questions.hint: Ele trabalha num consultório com uma cadeira especial.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes trabalhos é feito principalmente no campo (zona rural)?
questions.hint: No campo há plantações e criações de animais.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes meios de transporte é aquático?
questions.hint: Ele anda na água.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual meio de transporte é mais antigo?
questions.hint: Pense em quais não precisam de motor.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual destes é um meio de comunicação mais antigo que o celular?
questions.hint: Antes da internet, como as pessoas mandavam notícias de longe?

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Qual meio de comunicação leva notícias para muitas pessoas ao mesmo tempo?
questions.hint: Pense em algo que a família toda pode ver na sala.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Dê um exemplo de como o trabalho de uma pessoa ajuda a sua comunidade.
questions.hint: Pense em quem trabalha na sua escola, no seu bairro ou no posto de saúde.

questions.subject: bss
questions.q: Como a vida das crianças mudou desde o tempo dos seus avós? Cite uma mudança.
questions.hint: Pense em brinquedos, escola, transporte ou comunicação.

en.topic: Review: sentences, conjunctions, paragraphs and speech

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word is a conjunction?
questions.hint: A conjunction joins two parts of a sentence.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best conjunction: I wore my coat ___ it was cold.
questions.hint: The second part gives a reason.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best conjunction: We went to the park ___ it started to rain.
questions.hint: Which word tells us about time?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the best conjunction: Do you want juice ___ water?
questions.hint: You are giving a choice.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which word is an adverb?
questions.hint: Adverbs often tell us how something is done.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which adverb tells us WHEN? 'Tomorrow we will visit the zoo.'
questions.hint: Look for the word about time.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Find the preposition in this sentence: The cat hid under the bed.
questions.hint: A preposition shows where something is.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which preposition fits? The book is ___ the shelf.
questions.hint: Which word tells you the position?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Choose the preposition of time: We have lunch ___ twelve o'clock.
questions.hint: Which word goes with a clock time?

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which sentence uses inverted commas correctly?
questions.hint: Only the words that are spoken go inside.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: In direct speech, where does the question mark go? "Where is my bag___ asked Zara.
questions.hint: The question mark belongs to the spoken words.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which is the correct way to write this? Mum said it is time for bed
options: Mum said, "It is time for bed."
Mum said "it is time for bed".
"Mum said, it is time for bed."
questions.answer: Mum said, "It is time for bed."
questions.hint: Put a comma before the speech and a capital at the start of the spoken words.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Why do writers start a new paragraph?
options: To show a new idea, time or place
To make the page look full
Only when they reach the end of a line
questions.answer: To show a new idea, time or place
questions.hint: Think about what changes in the story.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Which is the best opening sentence for a paragraph about hedgehogs' food?
options: Hedgehogs eat beetles, worms and slugs.
It was a sunny day at the beach.
questions.answer: Hedgehogs eat beetles, worms and slugs.
questions.hint: The first sentence should say what the paragraph is about.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Join these two sentences using a conjunction: 'Ella was tired. She kept running.'
questions.hint: Try a word that shows a surprise or contrast.

questions.subject: en
questions.q: Write one sentence of direct speech with a character asking a question. Use inverted commas correctly.
questions.hint: Remember the question mark goes inside the inverted commas.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Maya pulled on her wellies and grabbed the bucket. The sky was grey, and puddles covered the path. At the pond, she knelt down carefully and looked for frogspawn. What did Maya put on?
questions.hint: Look at the first sentence.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Maya pulled on her wellies and grabbed the bucket. The sky was grey, and puddles covered the path. At the pond, she knelt down carefully and looked for frogspawn. What was the weather like?
questions.hint: Look for clues about the sky and the path.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Maya pulled on her wellies and grabbed the bucket. The sky was grey, and puddles covered the path. At the pond, she knelt down carefully and looked for frogspawn. Where did Maya go?
questions.hint: Find the place in the last sentence.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Maya pulled on her wellies and grabbed the bucket. The sky was grey, and puddles covered the path. At the pond, she knelt down carefully and looked for frogspawn. What does 'knelt' mean?
questions.hint: It sounds like a body part.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Tom stared at the empty plate. Crumbs were everywhere, and the dog was licking its lips under the table. What do you think happened to the food?
questions.hint: Look at what the dog is doing.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Tom stared at the empty plate. Crumbs were everywhere, and the dog was licking its lips under the table. How do you think Tom feels?
questions.hint: He 'stared' at the empty plate.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: The old lighthouse stood at the edge of the cliff. Every night, its beam swept across the dark sea, warning ships to keep away from the rocks. Where did the lighthouse stand?
questions.answer: at the edge of the cliff
questions.hint: Look at the first sentence.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: The old lighthouse stood at the edge of the cliff. Every night, its beam swept across the dark sea, warning ships to keep away from the rocks. Why did the lighthouse shine at night?
options: to warn ships about the rocks
questions.answer: to warn ships about the rocks
questions.hint: Find the word 'warning'.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: The old lighthouse stood at the edge of the cliff. Every night, its beam swept across the dark sea, warning ships to keep away from the rocks. Which word means the same as 'swept' in this text?
questions.hint: Think about how the light travels over the sea.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What does it mean to 'retrieve' information from a text?
questions.hint: The answer is written in the words.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: What does it mean to 'infer'?
questions.hint: Like a detective.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Leo packed a torch, a sleeping bag and marshmallows into his rucksack. What do you predict Leo is going to do?
questions.hint: Think about where you would need all three things.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: The puppy wagged its tail and ran in circles when Gran came through the door. How does the puppy feel?
questions.hint: Wagging and running are clues.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Which sentence gives the main idea? 'Bees are very busy insects. They visit flowers, collect nectar and make honey in their hive.'
options: They make honey in their hive.
questions.hint: Which sentence covers everything else?

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: Priya held her certificate tightly and ran all the way home to show her mum. Why do you think Priya ran home? Use a clue from the text.
questions.hint: Think about how she felt about the certificate.

questions.subject: en_read
questions.q: Text: The wind howled and the windows rattled. Sam pulled the blanket up to his chin. How do you think Sam feels? Explain using the text.
questions.hint: Look at what the wind does and what Sam does.
